description: This file defines the RangeBinary class, which extends AbstractBinary, within the Twig templating engine. The class is responsible for compiling range expressions (e.g., '1..5') into PHP range() function calls.

classes.name: RangeBinary
classes.description: A class representing range binary expressions in Twig templates, responsible for compiling range syntax into PHP code.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the range binary operation into PHP code by generating a call to the range() function with the evaluated operands.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string operator representation for the range expression, i.e., '..'.
